Public offer

Public offer for communication services

Agreement on the provision of communication services to individuals. OJSC «Attelkom», licence of the Communications Regulator No. 0014/08. Edition approved by order of the General Director No. 112 of 12.03.2026, in force from 01.04.2026.

1. General provisions

1.1. This document is the public offer of OJSC «Attelkom» (the Operator) to conclude an agreement on the provision of communication services (home internet, mobile communication, fixed telephone) with any individual (the Subscriber).

1.2. The Subscriber accepts the offer by signing the registration card at a service centre, by activating a SIM card or by the first payment for the services. Acceptance means agreement with all the terms of this offer, the tariff plan chosen and the Full list of prices.

1.3. The Operator may change this offer and the tariffs, informing Subscribers on attelkom.net and at service centres not less than 10 days before the change takes effect.

2. Subject of the agreement

2.1. The Operator provides the services on the tariff plan chosen by the Subscriber within the coverage area of its network. The coverage area is shown on the coverage map and is approximate.

2.2. Equipment installed at the Subscriber's premises (modem, ONT terminal) remains the property of the Operator unless bought by the Subscriber, and is returned when the agreement ends.

3. Registration of the Subscriber

3.1. The agreement is concluded on presentation of an ID card or passport. A SIM card is registered to one person; a Subscriber may hold not more than ten SIM cards.

3.2. The Subscriber informs the Operator of a change of name or address within 30 days.

4. Payment

4.1. Services are paid in som in advance, by the tariff plan. Payment is accepted at service centres, through Attelkom Pay, at Talasbank and through pay terminals.

4.2. When the balance falls below zero, the services are suspended, except calls to emergency numbers. Home internet is suspended on the 1st day of the month following non-payment and reconnected within 24 hours after payment.

4.3. Unused minutes, SMS and gigabytes do not carry over to the next month unless the tariff plan says otherwise.

5. Rights and duties of the Operator

5.1. The Operator provides the services 24 hours a day, except planned technical works announced on status.attelkom.net not less than 24 hours in advance.

5.2. The Operator keeps the secrecy of communications and gives information about the Subscriber and the services provided only in the cases provided by the laws of the ISEZ.

5.3. The Operator restricts access to internet resources in the cases and in the manner set by the competent authorities of the ISEZ (see Restricted resources).

6. Rights and duties of the Subscriber

6.1. The Subscriber uses the services only for personal, family and household needs. Resale of services and the use of the network for sending mass unsolicited messages are not allowed.

6.2. The Subscriber does not use the services to break the laws of the ISEZ and does not use tools for bypassing restrictions on access to internet resources.

6.3. The Subscriber keeps the password to the personal account secret. Operations made with the Subscriber's password are deemed to be made by the Subscriber.

7. Quality of service

7.1. The Operator ensures the quality of the services in accordance with the technical norms in force.

7.2. Interruptions caused by failures of the electricity supply, weather, damage to lines by third parties and the condition of international channels are not grounds for recalculation.

7.3. An interruption of home internet through the fault of the Operator lasting more than 24 hours in a row is recalculated at the Subscriber's application.

7.4. The speed of the tariff plan is indicated as «up to» and is not guaranteed. It depends on the Subscriber's equipment, the load of the network and international channels and other factors.

8. Complaints

8.1. Complaints are accepted by the hotline 105, at service centres and in writing at the head office. The Operator answers a written complaint within 15 working days, a complaint about charges within 30 days.

9. Term and termination

9.1. The agreement is concluded for an indefinite term. The Subscriber may terminate it at any time at a service centre, after paying for the services received.

9.2. The Operator may terminate the agreement if the balance has been below zero for 90 days, or if a SIM card has not been used for 180 days. The number is then returned to the free pool.
